# One Smart Biz

> One Smart Biz is a Doha, Qatar digital consultancy providing web and app development, multimedia and VFX production, social media management, AI automation, financial services, visa assistance, and business formation support for Qatar and GCC businesses.

One Smart Biz helps companies launch, improve, and automate business operations with a practical mix of digital engineering, creative production, finance support, and Qatar-focused setup guidance.

Key facts:
- Canonical site: https://www.onesmartbiz.pro
- Location: Doha, Qatar
- Contact email: admin@onesmartbiz.pro
- WhatsApp: +974 5585 5221
- Main service areas: Web and App Development, Multimedia and VFX, Social Media Management, AI and Automation Services, Financial Services, VISA Assistance, Business Formation
- Public AI tool: AI Business Advisor for business analysis and strategic recommendations

## Services

- [Web and App Development](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/web-development): Next.js, React, TypeScript, mobile apps, business websites, portals, e-commerce, and custom web applications.
- [Multimedia and VFX](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/multimedia-vfx): Video production, motion graphics, brand films, reels, and visual effects.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/social-media-management): Content calendars, branded posts, reels, paid campaign support, and reporting.
- [AI and Automation Services](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/ai-automation): AI assistants, workflow automation, dashboards, integrations, and process improvement.
- [Financial Services](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/financial-services): Audit preparation, financial statements, bookkeeping, tax filing support, and finance automation.
- [VISA Assistance](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/visa-assistance): Visa readiness, document review, application coordination, renewals, and business mobility support.
- [Business Formation](https://www.onesmartbiz.pro/services/business-formation): Company setup, licensing guidance, documentation, entity planning, and launch support in Qatar.
